entry_schema.base_sha: 40-character lowercase effective comparison base SHA (the measured merge base)
entry_schema.head_python_content_fingerprint: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of all tracked Python blobs at the measured head; avoids self-reference while invalidating the exception when any measured Python content changes
entry_schema.expires_on: YYYY-MM-DD deliberate approver-controlled debt expiry; unlike floating tool versions, this intentional date makes stale exception debt fail closed
